content:
- Overestimate prices after sentiment spikes (especially >0.3) — model tends to overshoot and fail to correct downward.
- Underestimate sharp downward moves when sentiment is low or negative — model ignores risk-off signals.
- Lag in price corrections: model often delays downward adjustments after sentiment shifts to negative.
- Mean reversion bias: model overreacts to short-term sentiment swings, failing to revert to historical mean.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts overestimate volatility in early part of forecast window, then underestimate later.
- Sentiment-driven bias: when sentiment is >0.27, model tends to overpredict upward movement; when <0.18, underpredicts downward.
